cohort: The cohort comprised live births with isolated orofacial clefts in Brazil registered in the Live Birth Information System between 1999 and 2020.
finding: The study found that live births with orofacial clefts in Brazil between 1999 and 2020 were predominantly male, white, born by cesarean section with birthweight ≥2,500 g and gestational age ≥37 weeks, and had a national prevalence of 4.24/10,000.
mod_finding: Live births with orofacial clefts were more frequently born by cesarean section.
